'''Mons Calpe S.C.''' is a professional football and sporting club in [[Gibraltar]]. Founded in 2013, the club's first team competes in the [[Gibraltar Football League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://gibraltarfa.com/domestic-football/cup/rock-cup|title = Gibraltar Football Association}}</ref> Mons Calpe also has a U-23 squad, futsal teams and darts."}}
